methods.name: Participatory post-storm verification
methods.why: Record flooded blocks and open sewers with residents and civil defense rather than infer actual flooding from elevation.
methods.tools: QField or KoboToolbox; municipal incident records

methods.name: Terrain and proximity screening
methods.why: Intersect mapped blocks, drainage proximity and fine-resolution low spots to prioritize field visits, not confirm floods.

methods.name: Privacy-aware health response
methods.why: Coordinate rat observations and testing priorities with local public health staff without publishing identifiable patient data.

next_steps: Obtain official Pau da Lima boundary and local flood incident records for 2026 from Salvador authorities.
Collect field-verified open sewer, storm flooding and rat observations with community partners.
Request Yale Planet access and local elevation data; assess the full year only after it ends.
